caption: The drawing depicts a transparent blue glass pitcher with a wide, flared mouth and a pronounced, curved handle positioned on the right side. The pitcher is set inside a matching transparent blue glass basin that has a broad, outward-flaring rim. Both the pitcher and the basin are rendered with highlights and shading, indicating their glass material and smooth surfaces. The objects are centrally placed within a lightly outlined rectangular border on a plain, off-white background, and the colors used are primarily shades of blue and light turquoise with white reflections indicating light on the glass. The artist's signature, "Chas Oseau," is visible in the lower left corner inside the rectangular border.
title: Wash Bowl and Pitcher
